segments.sn21.3:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
segments.sn21.3:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā ca sāriputto āyasmā ca mahāmoggallāno rājagahe viharanti veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe ekavihāre.
segments.sn21.3:1.4: Atha kho āyasmā sāriputto sāyanhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā mahāmoggallāno tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā mahāmoggallānena saddhiṃ sammodi.
segments.sn21.3:1.5: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn21.3:2.2: parisuddho mukhavaṇṇo pariyodāto santena nūnāyasmā mahāmoggallāno ajja vihārena vihāsī”ti.
segments.sn21.3:2.4: Api ca, me ahosi dhammī kathā”ti.
segments.sn21.3:2.5: “Kena saddhiṃ panāyasmato mahāmoggallānassa ahosi dhammī kathā”ti?
segments.sn21.3:2.6: “Bhagavatā kho me, āvuso, saddhiṃ ahosi dhammī kathā”ti.
segments.sn21.3:2.7: “Dūre kho, āvuso, bhagavā etarahi sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
segments.sn21.3:2.8: Kiṃ nu kho, āyasmā, mahāmoggallāno bhagavantaṃ iddhiyā upasaṅkami;
segments.sn21.3:2.9: udāhu bhagavā āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ iddhiyā upasaṅkamī”ti?
segments.sn21.3:2.12: Api ca, me yāvatā bhagavā ettāvatā dibbacakkhu visujjhi dibbā ca sotadhātu.
segments.sn21.3:2.13: Bhagavatopi yāvatāhaṃ ettāvatā dibbacakkhu visujjhi dibbā ca sotadhātū”ti.
segments.sn21.3:2.14: “Yathākathaṃ panāyasmato mahāmoggallānassa bhagavatā saddhiṃ ahosi dhammī kathā”ti?
segments.sn21.3:3.3: Kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, āraddhavīriyo hotī’ti?
segments.sn21.3:3.4: Evaṃ vutte, maṃ, āvuso, bhagavā etadavoca –
segments.sn21.3:3.6: kāmaṃ taco ca nhāru ca aṭṭhī ca avasissatu, sarīre upasussatu maṃsalohitaṃ, yaṃ taṃ purisathāmena purisavīriyena purisaparakkamena pattabbaṃ na taṃ apāpuṇitvā vīriyassa saṇṭhānaṃ bhavissatīti.
segments.sn21.3:3.8: Evaṃ kho me, āvuso, bhagavatā saddhiṃ ahosi dhammī kathā”ti.
segments.sn21.3:4.1: “Seyyathāpi, āvuso, himavato pabbatarājassa parittā pāsāṇasakkharā yāvadeva upanikkhepanamattāya;
segments.sn21.3:4.2: evameva kho mayaṃ āyasmato mahāmoggallānassa yāvadeva upanikkhepanamattāya.
segments.sn21.3:4.3: Āyasmā hi mahāmoggallāno mahiddhiko mahānubhāvo ākaṅkhamāno kappaṃ tiṭṭheyyā”ti.
segments.sn21.3:5.1: “Seyyathāpi, āvuso, mahatiyā loṇaghaṭāya parittā loṇasakkharāya yāvadeva upanikkhepanamattāya;
segments.sn21.3:5.2: evameva kho mayaṃ āyasmato sāriputtassa yāvadeva upanikkhepanamattāya.
segments.sn21.3:5.3: Āyasmā hi sāriputto bhagavatā anekapariyāyena thomito vaṇṇito pasattho –
segments.sn21.3:7.1: Itiha te ubho mahānāgā aññamaññassa subhāsitaṃ sulapitaṃ samanumodiṃsūti.

lines: Tadā kira bahū āgantukā bhikkhū sannipatiṃsu.
Tasmiṃ pariveṇaggena vā vihāraggena vā senāsanesu apāpuṇantesu dvinnaṃ therānaṃ eko gabbho sampatto.
Te divā pāṭiyekkesu ṭhānesu nisīdanti, rattiṃ pana nesaṃ antare cīvarasāṇiṃ pasārenti.
Dibbacakkhudibbasotadhātuvihārena hi so vihāsi, tesañca rūpāyatanasaddāyatanasaṅkhātaṃ oḷārikaṃ ārammaṇaṃ.
Iti dibbacakkhunā rūpassa diṭṭhattā dibbāya ca sotadhātuyā saddassa sutattā so vihāro oḷāriko nāma jāto.
Dibbā ca sotadhātūti sāpi bhagavato saddasuṇanatthaṃ visujjhi.
Bhagavatopi therassa rūpadassanatthañceva saddasuṇanatthañca tadubhayaṃ visujjhi.
Tadā kira thero “kathaṃ nu kho etarahi satthā viharatī”ti ālokaṃ vaḍḍhetvā dibbena cakkhunā satthāraṃ jetavane vihāre gandhakuṭiyaṃ nisinnaṃ disvā tassa dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇi.
Evaṃ te aññamaññaṃ passiṃsu ceva, saddañca assosuṃ.

Yāvadeva upanikkhepanamattāyāti tiyojanasahassavitthārassa himavato santike ṭhapitā sāsapamattā pāsāṇasakkharā “himavā nu kho mahā, ayaṃ nu kho pāsāṇasakkharā”ti evaṃ yāva upanikkhepanamattasseva atthāya bhaveyyāti vuttaṃ hoti.
Loṇaghaṭāyāti cakkavāḷamukhavaṭṭiyā ādhārakaṃ katvā mukhavaṭṭiyā brahmalokaṃ āhacca ṭhitāya loṇacāṭiyāti dasseti.
Catubhūmakadhammesu labbhamānattā paññāya “catubhūmakadhamme anupavisitvā ṭhitaṭṭhenā”ti vuttaṃ.
